sentences.en: The young campers were kited out with new waterproof jackets.
sentences.zh: 露营的小朋友们都配备了新的防水夹克。

sentences.en: On the fifteenth of August, thousands of people fly kites.
sentences.zh: 八月十五那天，成千上万的人都放起了风筝。

sentences.en: My folding bike is the cleverest piece of kit, ever.
sentences.zh: 我那折叠自行车可是最聪明的一套装备。
